name: Drag-on Dragoon 10th Anniversary
summary:
Drag-on Dragoon 10th Anniversary Box is a special collector's edition released to celebrate the 10th anniversary of the Drag-on Dragoon (Drakengard) series, alongside the launch of Drag-on Dragoon 3. This comprehensive box set offers a deep dive into the rich and dark fantasy world of the series, created by Yoko Taro.

It includes:
Drag-on Dragoon 3 (Drakengard 3) Full Game
Drag-on Dragoon: World Inside
Drag-on Dragoon: Chips Music
Drag-on Dragoon: History Films
Drag-on Dragoon: Novel Prelude
Drag-on Dragoon: Visual Book
Kaine's Garb outfit DLC
Replica Recording Scripts
Double-sided poster
